newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai's East China Fair seals $2.2 bln in sales.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai's East China Fair seals $2.2 bln in sales.

text.p: The East China Fair, a major annual trade exposition for Shanghai and surrounding provinces, closed on Friday having secured export orders worth $2.2 billion, about the same as last year, organisers said.
The top-selling category was textile products with export deals worth $723.9 million finalised, they said. Light industrial products followed with orders of $466.5 million.
The fair opened on March 5 with a total of 2,537 exhibitors from eight provinces as well as Shanghai participating, organisers added.
